bullets.text: Chennai police arrested three people within six hours of a youth murder in Adyar, and the office should monitor public safety measures.
TTV Dhinakaran criticized power outages in Thiruvallur after a funeral was disrupted at the Thirumazhisai electric crematorium, and the office should watch power reliability.
The Meteorological Centre warned of heavy rain in Thiruvallur district from November 3, and the office should coordinate disaster preparedness.
Authorities are clearing dumped construction debris meant to illegally grab government land along the Velachery-Taramani railway road, and the office should monitor anti-encroachment efforts.
Garbage and stagnant rainwater inside Thiruvanmiyur MRTS station exit stairs caused a foul stench, and the office should ensure immediate sanitation cleanup.
The Water Resources Department stepped up estuary dredging from Pudhupattinam to Pazhaverkadu to improve flood discharge, and the office should track monsoon mitigation progress.
Ponneri municipality refused to accept garbage, leaving the panchayat stranded for dumping space, and the office should assist in resolving waste management logistics.
Gummidipoondi traders seized a highway department vehicle over roadside vending disputes, and the office should mediate local vendor grievances.
Minister announced that Tamil Nadu set aside Rs 50 crore for startups to foster game studios and AI creation, and the office should oversee fund allocation.
The Tamil Nadu government is planning restricted student Wi-Fi to block harmful online games, and the office should review the technical implementation framework.
L&T's digital infrastructure business Vyoma.AI broke ground on a 52 MW data centre in Chennai, and the office should support AI infrastructure expansion.
An academic alleged unlawful detention by Tambaram police over a fake social media post concerning a TVK MLA, and the office should monitor police accountability.
Tamil Nadu BJP president Nainar Nagendran condemned the state government over law and order issues, and the office should track political opposition responses.
